question: What capacity allows even a wise person, while burning, to act at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence?
premises: Action is directed to the tip of nectar.
It is done with the tip of essence.
This occurs while burning, even for one who is wise.
inference: Even a wise person, in a burning state, can engage at the tip of nectar by means of the tip of essence.
uncertainties: Exact practice and result not detailed
plain_english: Even a wise person, while burning, takes the tip of nectar with the tip of essence.
